label: A catch hidden in the elimination of the IRS
description: A warning that there is a catch in the move to eliminate the IRS, given before the public discussion of exempting people earning below two hundred thousand dollars, and tied back to his earlier warning about the Iraqi dinar and people not paying taxes. He does not say what the catch is.
aliases: There's something there that's a catch
way before they even started talking about this

label: Side deals branching off the Ukraine mineral agreement
description: A realigning of infrastructure over Ukraine with rebuilding and construction contracts branching off the main mineral deal like twigs off a vine, involving influential Democratic and Republican politicians whom he says he sees but will not name, with important papers shredded as it comes to full manifestation. The minerals agreement was signed on 30 April 2025, three days before this.
aliases: the main mineral deal, and then many twigs

label: A United Islamic Front with Syria on a crutch
description: An uprising out of the Middle East reaching into Africa and South America, with Iraq to be watched and Iran shrinking back like an unwanted stepchild, Saudi Arabia reaching out to others, Turkey involved in Syria, Syria seen fatally wounded on the right side with the leg blown off walking on a crutch, and Egypt named, forming a United Islamic Front. Egypt and Turkey have been rivals across Libya and the eastern Mediterranean, which makes the pairing the hardest part.
aliases: Syria as a person who has been wounded fatally

label: Benjamin Franklin at the oak, and a revolutionary discovery near
description: Told to look to the oak and its strength, then seeing Benjamin Franklin with his spectacles and the kite and key discovering electricity by the oak tree, with a great and revolutionary discovery about to come near. The Franklin imagery frames the announcement rather than describing what is found.

label: The half circle flag on the Capitol, and America at a crossroads
description: A light on a half circle American flag on white buildings that look like the Capitol, in darkness, with America at a crossroads where great decisions are being made and great change is ahead, and the wealth transfer seen on the people. Crossroads and great change carry no content that could fail.
aliases: one of those flags that go half circle
I see the wealth transfer on the people

label: God dealing with America, England and Australia together
description: He is told this is not only about America: God is dealing with America, with England and with Australia, and he notes their flags are all red, white and blue as they come up before him. The shared flag colours are offered as the connecting detail.
aliases: I'm dealing with America. And I'm dealing with England
they all have the same kind of flags

label: Fruit the size of baseballs in Israel
description: Fruit the size of baseballs and massive agriculture in Israel with a prosperity over their produce, as God breathes on the Abrahamic covenant to show the world he is still the God over Israel. The baseball comparison is specific enough to check against horticultural reporting.
aliases: I saw fruit the size of baseballs
